description.value: Song (Kin Kao Song) is a Thai dine-in and takeout restaurant in Vancouver's Mt. Pleasant neighbourhood, operated by the same team behind Kin Kao on Commercial Drive. The kitchen is led by a Bangkok-native executive chef who imports spices directly from Thailand and pairs them with locally sourced daily ingredients, delivering refined street-style and home-cooked Thai dishes. Cyclists riding East Broadway will find a compact, focused menu with reservations via OpenTable and a full takeout option.
